title: Book Two · Chapter 194: The Next Pair of Hands
story:
The fourth Wednesday is the last afternoon of the trial. Ronan has a small box of checked pages. The other trial girl has the labels for the shelves.

Miss Wu asks them to prepare the box for the next helper. They need to mark the current pages and count the copies. They must put questions for the teacher on a separate note.

Ronan writes a long note. When he finishes, the girl tilts her head and reads it.

“Which pile is ready?” she asks.

He points. “This one.”

“Your note starts with the old pages. I thought those were ready.”

He reads the first sentence. It is true, but it sends her to the wrong pile first.

“I will change the order,” he says.

She suggests a large label for READY. The open question can go on another slip. Ronan keeps the useful facts from his first note. She puts a large label on the front of each pile. A helper can read the label first.

Both names go on the work record. Ronan writes how they helped each other.

Leo comes to use the box for the next group session. Miss Wu asks him to follow the note without questions first.

He takes the ready pile. He leaves the question for Miss Wu in its tray. Then he checks the copy number and looks at the current date.

“I can use this,” he says.

Ronan wants to explain how they prepared the box. Leo already has the right pages in his hands. Ronan lets him take them.

The trial girl puts the unused labels away. She has to leave on time for a family visit. Ronan checks the table with her. They sign the work sheet before she goes.

He has a few minutes left. He returns the spare pencils and wipes a dusty corner of the shelf. Then he puts his chair under the table.

Miss Wu calls the three trial students. Their checked sheets will be ready at lunch tomorrow. The four afternoons are complete. Their regular lessons continue as usual.

Outside, Ronan finds Mei with a paper sign. She has made the date larger again.

“Can you read this?” she asks.

He steps to the paving stone and reads it aloud. One small line is hidden by her hand.

“Your thumb is closed until Friday,” he says.

Mei moves her hand and laughs. He reads the line correctly.

Ronan walks home with his own school bag. The hour's work is finished. Mum is still out on an afternoon delivery. He reaches the green door first. He puts water on to heat before she comes home.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

label＝标签；tilt＝使倾斜；spare＝备用的；delivery＝送货、交付。

## 理解问题

1. 同伴怎样发现Ronan原交接说明的问题，两人怎样改进？
2. 这次合作为什么应记录两个人，而不是假称独立完成？

## 读句子

**He leaves the question for Miss Wu in its tray.**

拆开看：He / leaves the question for Miss Wu / in its tray.

他／把要问Miss Wu的问题／留在托盘里。
